policy.purpose: Separate workflow responsibility from CI Watchtower run-to-track attribution without changing verification behavior.
policy.workflowResponsibility: A workflow has one primary technical responsibility and may expose multiple capability tags.
policy.watchtowerBinding: CI Watchtower v0.3.2 uses three producer classes: project-wide workflows stay unassigned, dedicated workflows emit a canonical static [WT:<track>] run-name, and shared technical workflows resolve attribution dynamically from explicit PR/commit/branch evidence or workflow_dispatch inputs surfaced through run-name.
policy.preservation: Existing workflow triggers, jobs, scripts, runtime probes, database harnesses, release jobs, and production probes are preserved until equivalence is proven before consolidation; proven duplicate verifier executions may then move to their canonical owner without deleting unique coverage.

security.mode: dedicated-shared-technical-contract-suite; canonical owner after green equivalence proof; duplicate current-main executions removed

siteE2E.mode: contract-in-canonical-ci; hosted runtime harness preserved separately

backend.mode: cross-cutting responsibility across admin, product-query, trust, offer and current-main health

database.mode: canonical shared technical authority for migration inventory, historical-equivalence documentation and non-production target safety; full repository replay is not yet claimed; domain-specific Supabase runtime remains distributed

supplyChain.mode: canonical shared technical owner; lockfile integrity, npm audit non-regression gate and CodeQL; GitHub Dependency Review pending repository Dependency Graph enablement

aiProviderRuntime.mode: canonical shared technical owner after green equivalence proof; hermetic provider transport runtime on PR/push plus explicit non-persistent live OpenAI smoke on workflow_dispatch; duplicate current-main Unified Vision execution removed

mobileArchitecture.mode: six-lane mobile responsibility split with canonical Android Runtime artifact reuse active; legacy Android Native Shell / MOBILE-20A / MOBILE-20B workflow names are lightweight required-check compatibility gates because classic branch-protection requirements are not readable by the current integration

apiIntegration.equivalenceEvidence: PR #746 same-head Mobile API integration contracts + Mobile application contracts + Current Main Health GREEN

currentMain.equivalenceEvidence: PR #746 same-head dedicated Mobile owners + Current Main Health GREEN

androidRuntime.equivalenceEvidence: PR #749 head bb3cc23c6d03b25fcc0a781b15a2ba9f1ea0b96f: canonical APK producer + Native Shell + MOBILE-20A + MOBILE-20B + all three legacy Android workflows + Current Main Health GREEN on the same head

androidRuntimeConsolidation.compatibilityGate: legacy job names wait for the same-head canonical mobile-android-runtime.yml run and fail closed unless it completes successfully
androidRuntimeConsolidation.cutoverRule: duplicate Android builds/emulators are retired after same-head equivalence; compatibility shims remain until classic required-check configuration can be audited safely

workflowRegistry.invariant: Registry filenames and entry.workflow values must exactly match .github/workflows; inventory digests are computed at verification time and are not committed.
